function.name: ask_user
function.description: Pause an interactive turn to request new information or a decision that is required before work can continue. Never use this tool to deliver an answer, result, status update, or confirmation of work already completed; return those in the assistant final response.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List files and directories relative to the workspace root.

function.name: grep_files
function.description: Search UTF-8 text files under a directory using a regex pattern. Supports glob-based include/exclude filtering and context lines. Results are formatted as path:line:content with optional surrounding context.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

include.description: Glob pattern(s) to include (e.g. '*.py', ['*.ts', '*.tsx']). Only matching files are searched.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before and after each match (0-5, default: 0)

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file relative to the workspace root.

function.name: file_line_count
function.description: Count total, non-empty, and empty lines in a UTF-8 text file relative to the workspace root.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a UTF-8 text file relative to the workspace root.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace a substring in a file. The search string must match exactly (including whitespace and indentation). If the search string appears multiple times, you must provide more surrounding context to make it unique, or set replace_all=true. On mismatch, a diagnostic is shown with the closest match and line numbers.

function.name: patch_file
function.description: Apply multiple exact-text replacements to one file in a single operation.

function.name: batch_copy
function.description: Copy files or directories. Supports both files and directories.

function.name: batch_move
function.description: Move files or directories to a new location.

function.name: batch_delete
function.description: Delete files or directories. Directories require recursive=true.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a common development command from an allowlist. Supports optional timeout parameter (1-600 seconds).

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch content from a URL. Supports HTML (extracted to text), JSON, and plain text. Useful for reading documentation, APIs, or web content.

url.description: The URL to fetch content from

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the public web through a bounded built-in provider chain. Returns titles, safe result URLs, and snippets without API keys.

function.name: todo_write
function.description: Create or update a list of tasks. Use this to track progress on multi-step tasks. Each task has content (required) and status (pending/in_progress/completed). Pass the complete list each time to update.

todos.description: Complete list of tasks to track. Each task must have 'content' (string) and optionally 'status' (pending/in_progress/completed).

function.name: task
function.description: Run or manage a sub-agent for a complex task. Choose agent_type by the work, not by habit: a task that creates or modifies files -> 'workflow' (pass write_paths and verification_commands and the scheduler constructs WorkflowRequest.v1 for you, or provide an explicit workflow_request); broad codebase search or understanding -> 'explore' (read-only; several issued in one step run in parallel); deep analysis or design before acting -> 'plan' (read-only). The default action 'run' waits for the final result. Use 'spawn' with read-only 'explore'/'plan', then 'poll' or 'cancel' with the returned ID, when the parent should continue working concurrently. The sub-agent runs in its own isolated context with a turn limit. 'workflow' runs a centrally scheduled, typed Analyst -> Executor -> Verifier -> Reviewer flow. 'general' is a legacy-embedder compatibility type and the production Agent Loop rejects it. 'general' and 'workflow' always run one at a time. All sub-agents share the current turn's model-call/token/cost budget. The sub-agent's final result is returned to you.

action.description: Lifecycle operation. Defaults to synchronous 'run'. Only explore/plan support asynchronous 'spawn'.

subagent_id.description: Opaque ID returned by spawn; required by poll/cancel.

wait_seconds.description: For poll only: wait this many seconds for a terminal result before returning. Defaults to 10 to avoid busy polling with model calls.

description.description: Short 3-5 word description of the task

prompt.description: Full, self-contained task description for the sub-agent. The sub-agent runs in a fresh context and cannot see this conversation, so include every file path, constraint, and piece of background it needs.

agent_type.description: Type of sub-agent: 'workflow' (the required production path for delegated state-changing work — creating or modifying files — with typed role boundaries and scheduler-owned gates), 'explore' (fast, read-only codebase search), 'plan' (thorough, read-only analysis and design), or deprecated legacy-only 'general'.

write_paths.description: agent_type=workflow convenience field: relative paths the Executor may modify. Optional — omit it when you cannot name the files yet and the workflow runs fail-closed with an empty declared write set. When set, verification_commands is required so the change has executable proof.

verification_commands.description: agent_type=workflow convenience field: verification commands as argv vectors, e.g. [["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q"]] (plain command strings are accepted and split). Commands must come from the closed verifier grammar (pytest/unittest/ruff check/mypy/pyright/compileall, or npm/cargo/go/make/dotnet/cmake test/build/lint/typecheck forms).

parallel_explore.description: Deprecated legacy workflow only: run three read-only explore agents in parallel (architecture, tests, risks) and write their findings to the shared mailbox before planning.

workflow_request.description: Explicit WorkflowRequest.v1 for the production central scheduler: it fixes routing facts, path scope, acceptance criteria, and direct-argv checks. Valid only for agent_type=workflow. Optional: when omitted, the scheduler constructs the request from write_paths and verification_commands, or runs the fail-closed legacy route when no write paths are declared.

function.name: subagent_note_write
function.description: Write a bounded note to the current turn's shared sub-agent mailbox. Use this to hand a plan, finding, or result to another isolated sub-agent without putting raw context in a prompt.

key.description: Stable note key, e.g. workflow_plan or workflow_result

function.name: subagent_note_read
function.description: Read one note from the current turn's shared sub-agent mailbox.

function.name: subagent_note_list
function.description: List keys in the current turn's shared sub-agent mailbox.

function.name: git
function.description: Git workflow tool. Actions: status (show working tree status), diff (show unstaged changes), log (show recent commits), commit (create a git commit with message), review (review recent changes and working tree).

function.name: find_symbols
function.description: Find all Python symbols (classes, functions, variables) in files or directories. Use this to understand code structure before making changes.

path.description: File or directory path to search (default: current directory)

function.name: find_references
function.description: Find all references to a Python symbol (class, function, variable) across files. Use this before renaming to see impact.

symbol_name.description: Name of the symbol to find references for

path.description: File or directory path to search (default: current directory)

function.name: get_ast_info
function.description: Get AST information for a Python file including structure, imports, and statistics. Use this to understand file organization.

function.name: code_review
function.description: Review Python code quality by checking for unused imports, hardcoded values, missing docstrings, and long functions. Use this after making changes to ensure code quality.

path.description: File or directory path to review (default: current directory)

checks.description: Types of checks to run (default: all)

function.name: file_tree
function.description: Display a visual file tree with file sizes, modification times, and type icons. Supports filtering by pattern and controlling depth.

path.description: Directory or file path to display (default: current directory)

function.name: diff_viewer
function.description: View differences between file versions with unified diff, inline diff, or stats. Supports comparing files, showing before/after, or comparing against current file on disk.

files.description: List of files to compare. Each entry: {path, before?, after?}. Use '__file__' to load from disk.

before.description: Original content (or '__file__' to load from disk)

after.description: New content (or '__file__' to load from disk)

context_lines.description: Number of context lines around changes (default: 3)

function.name: test_runner
function.description: Discover and run Python tests automatically. Supports pytest and unittest frameworks. Provides structured results with pass/fail counts, failure details, and optional coverage reporting.

path.description: Directory or file path to test (default: current directory)

coverage.description: Enable coverage reporting (default: false, requires pytest-cov)

function.name: load_skill
function.description: Load a local SKILL.md by name or qualified directory/name.

function.name: propose_skill
function.description: Use before creating a new Skill or SKILL.md. Recommend where the Skill should live, generate frontmatter, check duplicate risks, and validate declared tools without writing files.
